artworks.title: Jamie Dimon Slams Crypto Tokens as ‘Decentralized Ponzi Schemes’
artworks.quote: I’m a major skeptic on crypto tokens, which you call currency, like Bitcoin, They are decentralized Ponzi schemes.

artworks.title: Bitcoin Has No Value
artworks.quote: Cryptocurrencies basically have no value and they don't produce anything. They don't reproduce, they can't mail you a check, they can't do anything, and what you hope is that somebody else comes along and pays you more money for them later on, but then that person's got the problem. In terms of value: zero.
